description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Task' within the Opencart admin marketplace module. It manages tasks such as listing, starting, pausing, clearing, deleting, updating status, and retrieving logs of marketplace tasks. It interacts with models for task data, manages permissions, and renders views related to marketplace task management.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Controller class handling marketplace task operations such as listing, starting, pausing, deleting, changing status, and logging within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads language files, sets up breadcrumbs, page title, and renders the marketplace task view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to fetch and display the list of tasks.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves task data with filtering, pagination, and constructs the view output for task listing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates background task execution using shell commands, typically to start processing tasks.

methods.name: cli
methods.description: Processes tasks sequentially from the database, executed via command line, handling success, failure, and logging.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Sets the status of pending tasks to paused, stopping their execution temporarily.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all tasks from storage, resetting the task queue.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected tasks from the system.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Updates the status of selected tasks to a specified value (pending, processing, paused, complete, failed).

methods.name: log
methods.description: Displays the log view for task histories.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Retrieves paginated log entries related to task processing and renders the log view.
